name: command_summons
summary: What each of a commander's summons gets: an order (the command action) gives the summons it reaches AP for their next turn, and a held command spell gives every summon a bonus to attack while it is held.

name.description: Who commands; it makes the commander's modifiers a source of their own.

perk.description: A feature with a command object, which an order uses.

modifiers.description: The commander's modifiers; those on command change an order's cost.

concentration.description: The spell the commander holds; a held command gives its bonus only while held. A key that names no spell is an error.

summons.description: The names of the commander's active summons.

ap.description: What the order costs the commander, 0 without an order.

modifiers.description: Per summon name, the modifiers it gets; every summon is listed.
